selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: In the first du'a, what do we ask Allah to make us among?
questions.answer: People of happiness, safety, the Qur'an, and belief.

questions.question: Whom do we ask Allah to bless with peace and blessings?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, his family, and his companions.

questions.question: The prayer talks about the letters and words of what holy book?
questions.answer: The Qur'an.

questions.question: Who is reciting the Qur'an in this prayer?
questions.answer: All the people who read the Qur'an.

questions.question: From when until when does the prayer mention Qur'an recitation?
questions.answer: From its first coming down until the end of time.

questions.question: Besides us, which family members do we ask Allah to have mercy on?
questions.answer: Our parents.

questions.question: Which other people do we ask Allah to have mercy on?
questions.answer: Believing men and believing women.

questions.question: How does the passage end in praising Allah?
questions.answer: By saying all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all worlds.

questions.question: What good things are named in the opening supplication?
questions.answer: Happiness, safety, the Qur'an, and belief.

questions.question: Is the prayer only for one person or for many people? How can you tell?
questions.answer: It is for many people, because it says us, our parents, and all believing men and women.

questions.question: Who is called “our Master” in the prayer?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Which people close to the Prophet are also mentioned after him?
questions.answer: His family and his companions.

questions.question: What tiny parts of the Qur'an are counted in the blessing prayer?
questions.answer: Its letters.

questions.question: What does the prayer say carries the sound when the Qur'an is read?
questions.answer: The waves in the air.

questions.question: Which group of believers is included so no one is left out?
questions.answer: Both men and women.

questions.question: What is the final sentence doing?
questions.answer: Praising Allah.

questions.question: In the first line, who are we speaking to?
questions.answer: Allah.

questions.question: What are the four things we ask to be connected with?
questions.answer: Happiness, safety, the Qur'an, and belief.

questions.question: In the second du'a, what do we ask Allah to send upon Prophet Muhammad?
questions.answer: Peace and blessings.

questions.question: Who else receives that same du'a with the Prophet?
questions.answer: His family and companions.

questions.question: The prayer remembers readers of the Qur'an from long ago until later times. What does that show?
questions.answer: The Qur'an is read across all times.

questions.question: Name two groups of people we ask Allah to show mercy to.
questions.answer: Our parents and all believing men and women.

questions.question: What special name of Allah is used near the end?
questions.answer: The Most Merciful of the merciful.

questions.question: Which wider group do we ask mercy for after that?
questions.answer: All believing men and women.
